# SQLite amalgamation

This directory contains SQLite 3.44.2, Fossil check-in
`ebead0e7230cd33bcec9f95d2183069565b9`, as reported by the header of
`sqlite3.c`.

The application compiles the amalgamation with `SQLITE_THREADSAFE=1` and
`SQLITE_OMIT_LOAD_EXTENSION`. The source is dedicated to the public domain;
see `LICENSE.md` and the notices embedded in the amalgamation.

Source-file SHA-256 values used for this release:

- `sqlite3.c`: `16e8a29fc022b8e80a6ebb376250a1b8e786b839b44840b0fe86e94159b84ae6`
- `sqlite3.h`: `d91614928370d8b5033a3dab3c07d0438b342848a82b71199963bd5f93b4331f`
